subject: Vendor portal ownership & evidence handback for SIG mapping
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG - vendor portal + evidence items

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We need to get Acme Analytics set up in Vendr so they can review our SIG responses and request evidence. Procurement also asked for a short mutual action plan (timeline + owner).

Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will own the Vendr portal (uploading documents, answering text fields)?
- Which artifacts you can provide immediately (SOC 2, network diagram, user access policy).
- Whether you have a preferred cadence for rotating evidence (annual, quarterly).

We flagged a handful of SIG questions requiring diagrams and a few CAIQ mappings. If you can provision an editor account to our security reviewer that would speed things up.

Attaching the SIG extract we care about.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics
[attachment: acme_sig_subset.csv (csv)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG - vendor portal + evidence items

Jordan — thanks for the note.

Short answers up front:
- Portal owner: Laura Bennett (SecOps lead) will own the Vendr profile and be the day-to-day uploader. Laura is cc'd.
- Immediate artifacts: SOC2 report (2025), network diagram (v2), and access policy draft are available; I'll push redacted copies to the portal.
- Evidence rotation: we propose annual rotation for SOC2 artifacts and quarterly reviews for diagrams/policies tied to production changes. Happy to accelerate if you need tighter windows for procurement.

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Vendr team to provision a security-reviewer editor account for jordan@acme-analytics.com (or a read-only reviewer if preferred).
2) Laura will upload the initial evidence bundle and map answers to the SIG fields we care about.
3) Shared drive link and HubSpot record will be attached to the portal entry for traceability.

I'll attach the SOC2 report and network diagram to this thread for your initial review — redacted where necessary.

Best,
Priyom Das
Security PM, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOC2_report_2025.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: network_diagram_v2.png (png)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG - vendor portal + evidence items

Priyom / team — quick operational notes from a procurement angle: 
- Procurement will ask for a brief MSA/terms excerpt; I can surface that once we have the Vendr portal link.
- For SOC2 evidence, procurement usually accepts the SOC2 report + bridge letter for recency. Rishi — can your team produce a short bridge note if needed?
- On rotation cadence: quarterly reviews are fine for policies/diagrams. For SOC2 we stick to annual but will provide a bridge letter in-between audits.

Laura — when you upload, please: 1) label files with "Acme-SIG-<artifact>-YYYY", 2) add a short summary text in each portal field explaining redactions, and 3) tag anything that contains customer-identifiable data so Vendr can mark it as restricted.

On the SIG mapping: Neha, can you take the lead mapping the SIG rows to our internal controls? I'll coordinate with procurement on the timeline (target: complete onboarding within 10 business days after portal access).

Thanks — short replies are fine.

—Marissa
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Lia Chen <lia.chen@vendr.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Vendr access provisioned: Acme Analytics workspace

Hi all,

Thanks for the heads up — I've provisioned the Acme Analytics workspace and invited jordan@acme-analytics.com as a "Security Reviewer" and laura_bennett@redwood.com as an "Owner". The portal link is: https://vendr.com/portal/AcmeAnalytics/records/12345 (also pasted in metadata).

A couple of practical notes:
- File types: PDF/DOCX/PNG are preferred; please avoid zips containing mixed filetypes.
- Field mapping: Vendr accepts free-text for SIG answers; for CAIQ mappings we recommend adding the CAIQ question ID in parentheses after the answer (e.g., "SC-01 (CAIQ:1.2.3)").
- Role matrix: attached is a small CSV showing recommended portal roles. Please confirm if you need additional custom roles.

I'm available for a 15-min handoff call Monday if you want me to walk Laura through the uploader UI.

Regards,
Lia Chen
Client Success — Vendr
